facets.textHint: Matches part of the name or code

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.text: It can no longer be used as a sales context, and its listings stop showing in pickers. Existing documents are not changed.

code.label: Code
code.hint: Latin letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, up to 80. Saved in capitals. It cannot change after creation.

name.label: Name
name.hint: The name people see in lists and documents. Up to 160 characters.

type.label: Type
type.hint: How sales reach customers through this channel. It cannot change after creation.

active.label: Active
active.hint: Inactive channels cannot be used for new sales or listings.

linkActive.label: Active link
linkActive.hint: Turn on to use this channel in {{branch}}; turn off to stop using it while keeping the link.

branches.title: Branches
branches.createFirst: Create the channel first, then link branches.

errors.codeTaken: This code is already used by another channel of this company.
errors.codePattern: Use Latin letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

toast.companyChanged: The company changed. Unsaved channel changes were discarded.

conflict.title: This channel changed
conflict.text: Someone else changed it. Reload, or keep your changes and save again.

states.loadFailed: The channels could not be loaded.
